clips.title: 彭博有限合伙企业：印度AI三难困境，数据大国如何破局？

subtitles.en: Think about the digital footprint you leave behind every single day, every text you send, every video you stream, every payment you tap on your phone and every route you trace on a map.
subtitles.zh: 想想你每天留下的数字足迹：每条短信、每个视频、每次支付、每条导航路线。

subtitles.en: Now multiply that by 1.5 billion people. That is India. It generates close to 20% of the world's data.
subtitles.zh: 再乘以15亿人，这就是印度。它产生了全球近20%的数据。

subtitles.en: And yet India still does not have a frontier artificial intelligence model of its own. It relies on models built by companies like OpenAI, Google and Anthropic.
subtitles.zh: 然而印度仍没有自己的前沿AI模型，依赖OpenAI、谷歌和Anthropic等公司。

subtitles.en: India is facing an artificial intelligence trilemma. It needs to build an independent or sovereign AI ecosystem at catch-up speed and with a fraction of the resources that the US and China have.
subtitles.zh: 印度面临AI三难困境：需以追赶速度、用远少于美中的资源，构建独立AI生态。

subtitles.en: My guests today believe it's possible. Sovereignty is not self-sufficiency. Sovereignty means a smart way of interdependence with clearly identified things that I must own.
subtitles.zh: 主权不等于自给自足，而是明智的相互依存，明确哪些必须自主掌控。

subtitles.en: Srikanth Velma Kani is co-founder of Enterprise AI firm Fractal Analytics, the country's first publicly listed pure-play AI company.
subtitles.zh: Srikanth Velma Kani是Fractal Analytics联合创始人，印度首家纯AI上市公司。

subtitles.en: He is also the chairperson of NASCARM, the body that represents India's $300 billion IT industry.
subtitles.zh: 他也是NASCARM主席，该机构代表印度3000亿美元的IT产业。

subtitles.en: I don't think you need to fit a square peg in a round hole. You need all kinds of models. You need the frontier capability models as well as very focused models.
subtitles.zh: 不需要削足适履，需要各种模型：前沿能力模型和高度聚焦的模型。

winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
